rationale: Stable v1.82.0 already contains the Properties syncNative early return that leaves the first decor owner selected after B/C creation. Restore the documented last-created selection and its text frame without changing drawing tools, storage or writer boundaries.

summary.ru: После создания фигуры свойства и рамка относятся к новому объекту; Esc отменяет незавершённое рисование.
summary.en: Newly created decor owns Properties and its selection frame; Escape cancels unfinished drawing.
